column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_connection.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry point of rel_connection: when arg is 0 registers the scene with system_scene_register(world_connection_scene_main 0x38, world_connection_scene_exit 0xe4, 0x00014b50). Returns 0. Side effects: the scene registration. No direct caller (module entry point). The pack header lists rel_shop shop_module_start as a twin; the code is the same pattern with different (masked) callbacks, so this copy keeps its own name.

Scene 0x13 start callback: turns the loading overlay off, creates the app (world_connection_app_create), installs world_connection_frame_draw_cb (0x1b4) and world_connection_leave_cb (0x1e4) as frame and leave callbacks for id 2, then loops world_connection_app_frame + system_wait_frame until the app finishes; finally sets the no-op callbacks, turns the loading overlay on, waits a frame and returns to the caller scene with system_scene_return(0x13, 0). The create call is tested for a non-zero result, but world_connection_app_create returns nothing visible (hypothesis: the test always passes, medium). No return value. Side effects: scene callbacks, scene return. Registered as the scene start callback by world_connection_module_start.
Empty scene end callback (8 bytes, jr ra; nop, returns at once). No side effects. No direct caller (registered as the scene end callback by world_connection_module_start).

Sets the thread attribute 0x4000, creates the module heap at module offset 0x14b70 of 0x300000 bytes (pointer 0x00314b70) and registers it as the delete heap, allocates the 0x30-byte app object (world_connection_app_construct, pointer 0x00014b60), initialises it (world_connection_app_init) and sets the running flag 0x00014b5c = 1. No return value. Side effects: heap creation, 0x00014b60, 0x00014b5c, 0x00314b70. Callers: 1 (world_connection_scene_main).

Runs one step of the app state machine (world_connection_app_update on 0x00014b60); when it reports completion clears the running flag 0x00014b5c. Returns true when the app has finished. Side effects: through the update, 0x00014b5c. Callers: 1 (world_connection_scene_main).

Frame callback: while the running flag 0x00014b5c is set draws the app (world_connection_app_draw on 0x00014b60). No return value. Side effects: display lists. No direct caller (installed by world_connection_scene_main through system_scene_set_frame_callback).

Leave callback: terminates the app (world_connection_app_term), deletes it through its vtable (+0x2c, slot +8), clears 0x00014b60, reads the heap usage (discarded), unregisters and frees the module heap 0x00314b70. No return value. Side effects: frees everything the module allocated. No direct caller (installed by world_connection_scene_main through system_scene_set_frame_callback).

Allocation function handed to field_3d_set_allocator by world_connection_app_init; the decompiled body is empty apart from the high half 0x310000 of the heap address (16 bytes, a tail jump that the decompiler drops); it has the same 16-byte shape as BOOT audio_heap_free with another callee, a one-instruction wrapper around a heap call on the module heap 0x00314b70 (hypothesis: system_heap_alloc, medium). Returns the block. Side effects: heap allocation. No direct caller (function pointer).

Free function handed to field_3d_set_allocator by world_connection_app_init; empty decompiled body (16-byte tail jump); by the identical twin BOOT audio_heap_free it frees ptr from the module heap 0x00314b70 with system_heap_free (medium). Returns that result. Side effects: heap release. No direct caller (function pointer).

Initialises the app object: releases all sound banks and loads tracks 0x2c8 and 0x2d2, clears the state words (+0, +8, +0xc..+0x18, +0x24, +0x28) and the overlay byte +4, installs world_connection_heap_alloc/free as the field_3d allocator, creates the task manager (world_connection_task_mgr_create), allocates the 0x704-byte resource object (world_connection_res_construct, app +0xc) and clears it, initialises the GE render state of layer 0, starts loading the language archive (world_connection_res_load_archive with world_connection_get_lang_archive_index) and starts a one-frame fade out. No return value. Side effects: audio banks, task manager 0x00314bd8, file loads, fade. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_create).

Allocates the five tasks of a round on the module heap and registers each with world_connection_task_register (update priority, draw priority, init): stage task 0xa4 bytes at app +0x10 (0, 0), game task 0x81c bytes at +0x14 (2, 2), radar 0x28 bytes at +0x18 (4, 4), HUD 0x24 bytes at +0x1c (5, 5) and partner pointer 0x30 bytes at +0x24 (7, 7). No return value. Side effects: heap allocations, task lists. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).

For each task pointer app +0x10, +0x14, +0x18, +0x1c, +0x20, +0x24, +0x28 that is set: world_connection_task_unregister(task, 1) and virtual delete (vtable +0x1c, slot +8), then clears the pointer. No return value. Side effects: task lists, heap. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).

App state machine (+0): reads the pad and runs all task updates (world_connection_task_mgr_update) first. 0: stops all sounds, 1. 1: when no load is pending creates the tasks, loads archive 0 (connection/data.ehp), the language archive and archives 7-0xb, the sprite sheets of character 1 and of the connection-parameter character/variant (world_connection_res_load_character), opens popup kind 3 (+0x20), sets a 60-frame delay (+8), clears the overlay, plays sound 0x7aac, 2. 2: counts the delay down, holds the popup at frame 0xd; when loads are done and the delay is over resets VRAM, uploads the GIMs of archives 7-0xb (field_3d_gim_upload_to_vram) and lets the popup run, 3. 3: when the popup is done deletes it and starts a 16-frame white fade in, 4. 4: waits for the fade, 5 (game running). 5: when the game task reports finished creates the result task (0x30 bytes, priority 9) and starts it with the collected count, the time left in hundredths ((frames * 100.0) / 30) and the cleared flag (remaining == 0), 6. 6: result outcome 3 -> 7; outcome 2 (again) -> fade out, overlay on, destroy the tasks, back to 0. 7: returns 1. Returns 1 only in state 7, else 0. Side effects: tasks, loads, VRAM, fades, sound. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_frame).
Returns word +0x2c of the result task (the result screen's outcome: 2 play again, 3 leave; 1 while running). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).
Returns the game task's countdown +0x804 in frames (starts at 18000). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_connection_hud_draw_timer, world_connection_app_update).
Returns 400 - world_connection_game_get_remaining(game): the number of students in both lines. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).
Returns game task byte +0x819, set to 1 in game state 0xb when the round is over. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).
Returns popup byte +0x8c, set when the popup layout has played its length. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).

Writes task byte +0x18 (update enabled; world_connection_task_mgr_update only updates tasks where it is 1). No return value. Side effects: the task. Callers: 3 (world_connection_game_update, world_connection_game_spawn_leaders, world_connection_app_update).

Writes app byte +4; when 1 world_connection_app_draw covers the screen with an opaque black sprite. No return value. Side effects: the app. Callers: 2 (world_connection_game_update, world_connection_app_update).
Returns the resource object's count of loads still in flight (+0x6fc). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).

Destroys all tasks (world_connection_task_mgr_destroy), terminates the field_3d render state, resets VRAM, frees every loaded buffer (world_connection_res_free_all), deletes the resource object (vtable +0x700, slot +8) and clears app +0xc, clears the field_3d allocator and releases tracks 0x2d2 and 0x2c8. No return value. Side effects: heap, VRAM, audio banks. Callers: 1 (world_connection_leave_cb).
Stores the app vtable 0x149f0 at +0x2c and the pointer in the singleton 0x00314b74. Returns app. Side effects: 0x00314b74. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_create).

Destructor: restores vtable 0x149f0, clears the singleton 0x00314b74 and, when flags > 0, frees the object (system_operator_delete). Returns app. Side effects: 0x00314b74, heap. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

On layer 5 disables depth test and texturing, enables alpha blending and draws a 480 x 272 sprite with ambient colour 0xff000000 (opaque black). No return value. Side effects: the layer 5 display list. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_draw).

Runs all task draws (world_connection_task_mgr_draw), draws the screen fade on layer 5 (system_draw_fade) and, when the overlay byte +4 is 1, the black overlay. No return value. Side effects: display lists. Callers: 1 (world_connection_frame_draw_cb).

Load callback (0xc3c) of the resource loads: when size >= 1 and the buffer starts with the 3-byte magic at 0x13730 (EHP), binds it (container_ehp_bind_with_callback); decrements the owner's pending count, stores the buffer into the request's destination slot and deletes the 12-byte request. Returns 1 when handled, 0 when size < 1. Side effects: archive binding, the resource object, heap. No direct caller (passed to container_load_file).
Decrements the pending-load counter +0x6fc. No return value. Side effects: the resource object. Callers: 1 (world_connection_res_on_loaded).

Clears the resource object: the 18-pointer archive table (0x48 bytes) and three 0x23c-byte (0x8f-entry) character tables at +0x48, +0x284 and +0x4c0, and the pending count +0x6fc. No return value. Side effects: the object. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_init).
Stores buffer into *slot (res is unused). No return value. Side effects: *slot. Callers: 1 (world_connection_res_on_loaded).

Returns archive slot index of the resource object (res + index * 4; 0 connection/data.ehp, 1-6 language archives, 7-0xb shared sprite sheets, 0xc-0x11 result archives). No side effects. Callers: 11 (world_connection_pointer_update, world_connection_res_find_bustup_sheet, world_connection_popup_update, world_connection_combo_update, ...).

Reads the character's two loaded sprite sheets: *out_body = res + 0x48 + character * 4, *out_head = res + 0x284 + character * 4. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_connection_char_draw).
When archive 0 (connection/data.ehp) is loaded returns its member sml_bup01.gim (the small portrait sheet), else NULL. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_hud_draw_portrait).

Gets the character's model entry words (world_get_character_model_entry_words(character, 0)) and maps them to the shared sheets loaded from archives 7-0xb: body name sd_body_01/02/03.gim -> res +0x1c/+0x20/+0x24, head name sd_head_01/02.gim -> res +0x28/+0x2c. Outputs not matched are left unchanged. No return value. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_connection_char_draw).

When slot index is empty, starts an asynchronous load of entry index of the path table 0x136a0 ({root, path} pairs; entry 0 connection/data.ehp): size query, a 12-byte request {slot, res, buffer}, buffer allocation on the module heap, container_load_file with callback world_connection_res_on_loaded, pending count + 1. No return value. Side effects: heap, file queue, +0x6fc. Callers: 2 (world_connection_app_init, world_connection_app_update).

Zeroes the three words of a load request. No return value. Side effects: the request. Callers: 3 (world_connection_res_load_sdchr_body, world_connection_res_load_sdchr_head, world_connection_res_load_archive).

column2: void world_connection_res_load_sdchr_body(void *res, int character, int variant)
column3: When slot +0x48 + character * 4 is empty, loads root 8 file connection/sdchr/<name> with name = world_get_character_word_10(character, variant) into it (same request scheme as world_connection_res_load_archive). No return value. Side effects: heap, file queue, pending count. Callers: 1 (world_connection_res_load_character).

column2: void world_connection_res_load_sdchr_head(void *res, int character, int variant)
column3: When slot +0x284 + character * 4 is empty, loads root 8 file connection/sdchr/<name> with name = world_get_character_word_14(character, variant) into it. No return value. Side effects: heap, file queue, pending count. Callers: 1 (world_connection_res_load_character).

column2: void world_connection_res_load_character(void *res, int character, int variant)
column3: When the character has no field model entry (world_character_has_field_model == 0) loads its two sdchr sprite sheets (world_connection_res_load_sdchr_body and _head). No return value. Side effects: file loads. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_update).
When buffer is set: runs the EHP extension handlers if it starts with the EHP magic 0x13730, then delete[] it. No return value. Side effects: heap. Callers: 1 (world_connection_res_free_all).

Frees the 18 archive slots and every entry (0x8f each) of the three character tables +0x48, +0x284, +0x4c0 with world_connection_res_free_buffer (pointers are not cleared). No return value. Side effects: heap. Reached through an import-style thunk (thunk_FUN_0000122c) from world_connection_app_term.

Maps save_get_language 0-5 to archive slot 1-6 (language l -> l + 1; out-of-range -> 1), the language archive connection/<l>.ehp with the popup layouts and HUD parts. The resource argument passed by callers is ignored. No side effects. Callers: 6 (world_connection_pointer_update, world_connection_app_init, world_connection_popup_update, world_connection_combo_update, ...).

Maps save_get_language to the result archive slot: 0 -> 0xc, 1 -> 0xd, 2 -> 0xf, 3 -> 0xe, 4 -> 0x10, 5 -> 0x11 (languages 2 and 3 swapped). No side effects. Callers: 2 (world_connection_result_task_start, world_connection_app_update).

Jump thunk (8 bytes: j 0x0000122c; nop) to world_connection_res_free_all. Arguments, return value and side effects are those of world_connection_res_free_all (documented in docs/subsystems/functions/world.md). Callers: 1 (FUN_00000a2c).
Stores the resource object vtable 0x149fc at +0x700. Returns res. No other side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_app_init).
Destructor: restores vtable 0x149fc and frees the object when flags > 0. Returns res. Side effects: heap. No direct caller (reached through a function pointer).

column2: void world_connection_stage_create_model(void *tms, void *tma, void *tmt, void *hmp, int hmp_size, void *heap)
column3: Builds the stage at 0x00314b78 (0x60 bytes, cleared first): model instance from tms (0x00314b7c), texture animation tma and animation tmt (played with index 0, flags 2) when given; copies the hmp walk grid (hmp_size bytes) into a heap block (0x00314b8c), saves vertex 0 at 0x00314b80 and subtracts it from every vertex so the grid is corner-relative (as in rel_field). No return value. Side effects: 0x00314b78..0x00314bd7, heap. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_update).

Copies three floats from src to dest and returns dest. Side effects: writes dest[0..2]. Callers: 10 (world_connection_clip_motion, world_connection_sample_floor_height, world_connection_stage_create_model, world_connection_radar_draw_dots, ...).

Destroys the stage model instance 0x00314b7c, frees the grid copy 0x00314b8c on its heap 0x00314b78 and clears the 0x60-byte stage block. No return value. Side effects: heap, 0x00314b78. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_term).

Advances the stage model by one tick: tail-jumps to field_3d_update_model(*(0x00314b7c), 0), the stage model instance of the stage block 0x00314b78, with a null step record (step 1.0). The decompiler shows an empty body because the whole call is a tail jump. Returns nothing. Side effects: the model instance frame/pose. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_update, every frame once the stage is loaded).

Prepares layer 1 for the 3D stage: world_connection_setup_3d_state, world_connection_setup_camera, world_connection_setup_lighting, commits the list and loads an identity model matrix. No return value. Side effects: layer 1 list, GU matrices. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_draw).

Draws the stage model: on layer 1 clears the stencil, enables stencil, depth, blending and alpha test, stencil ALWAYS ref 2 with REPLACE on pass; on layer 2 sets stencil test ref 0 and white ambient; translates by minus the grid origin 0x00314b80, marks the GU matrices dirty and draws the instance 0x00314b7c (field_3d_draw_model with a 0x34-byte hook {1, 2, ...}). No return value. Side effects: display lists, GU matrix stack. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_draw).
Copies pos to the camera target 0x00314b90. No return value. Side effects: 0x00314b90. Callers: 2 (world_connection_game_spawn_leaders, world_connection_player_move).

Returns the stage's walk-grid copy 0x00314b8c (hmp layout). No side effects. Callers: 4 (world_connection_partner_move, world_connection_player_move, world_connection_student_wander, world_connection_char_move_frozen).

Returns the cell byte (1 walkable, hmp.md) at column x, row z of the stage grid, index x + z * columns; 0 when no grid is loaded, x or z is outside columns/rows (+8/+0xa) or the index is not below the header's first halfword (vertex count). No side effects. Callers: 3 (world_connection_stage_update, world_connection_get_cell_at, world_connection_clip_motion).
Returns world_connection_get_cell(int(pos.x / 0.5), int(pos.z / 0.5)) (the decompiler drops the return). No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_student_wander).

Sets pos.y to the floor height of the stage grid at (x, z) with the triangle-plane formula of rel_field world_sample_floor_height (cell split on the v00-v11 diagonal; normal from the two edge vectors); leaves pos unchanged outside the grid. VFPU cross/dot helpers; lower confidence for the helper semantics. No return value. Side effects: pos[1]. Callers: 4 (world_connection_partner_move, world_connection_player_move, world_connection_student_wander, world_connection_char_move_frozen).

Writes the stage's GE state: offset (0x710, 0x778), viewport 480 x 272 centred at 0x800, depth range 0xffff..0, blending, scissor 480 x 272, depth test GEQUAL-type 7, culling, shading, fog (50..100, colour 0x404040), colour 0xff0000ff; projection = orthographic (-240, 240, -136, 136, -10000, 10000) scaled by the vector 0x137a8, view and model identity; linear texture filter. No return value. Side effects: the display list, GU matrices. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_begin_frame).

Sets the view matrix: eye = camera target 0x00314b90 + offset 0x12c00, look-at the target, up vector 0x137c0 (field_3d_camera_set_look_at), then identity model matrix. Returns list unchanged. Side effects: GU matrices. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_begin_frame).

Clears the light block 0x00314b9c (0x3c bytes) and sets it as light 0, white ambient, enables lighting and disables light 0. No return value. Side effects: the display list, 0x00314b9c. Callers: 1 (world_connection_stage_begin_frame).
Returns the cell array of the grid copy (grid + word +0x10), or NULL without a grid. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_get_cell).
Returns the vertex array of the grid copy (grid + word +0xc), or NULL without a grid. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_sample_floor_height).

column2: void * world_draw_character_sprite(void *list, void *tex_odd, void *tex_even, float *pos, int direction, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Draws a character as two textured quads (same code as rel_field): binds tex_even for even directions and tex_odd for odd ones, enables depth test, texturing, blending and alpha test, builds and draws the upper part (world_build_character_quad part 1) and the lower part (part 0) moved toward the camera (camera +0x30 scaled by 0x12eac); the model matrix is a translation to pos with a rotation about y by 0x12eb0. Arguments 5-7 in t0-t2. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: display list, GU matrix stack. Callers: 1 (world_connection_char_draw).

column2: void * world_draw_character_sprite_parts(void *list, void *tex_a, int cell_id, int level_a, void *tex_b, int level_b, float *pos, int direction, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Draws a character with a model entry as two screen-space parts (same code as rel_field): depth test, texturing, blending and alpha test; part 1 (world_build_character_part_quad(1, ...)) with tex_b at texture level level_b, then part 0 with tex_a at level_a, each between world_push_screen_matrices and world_pop_screen_matrices; the world matrix (translation to pos, rotation about y by 0x12eb0) is loaded for the projection done in the quad builder. Arguments 5-8 in t0-t3, 9-10 on the stack. Returns the advanced display list. Side effects: display list, GU matrices. Callers: 1 (world_connection_char_draw).

Keeps a moving character on walkable cells: speed = world_connection_vec3_length(velocity), direction normalised and rescaled; for each of four probe directions (constants 0x137d0, 0x137dc, 0x137e8, 0x137f4, normalised and scaled by the speed) it adds the probe to the four footprint corners of pos (world_get_cell_corners) and, when a corner lands on a cell that is not walkable (world_connection_get_cell == 0), lies below 0 or beyond the grid columns/rows (grid +8/+0xa), clears the velocity component pointing that way (probe 3 the positive x part, 2 the negative x part, 1 positive z, 0 negative z). Finally out += the clipped velocity. Returns out. VFPU helpers; medium confidence for the probe-to-axis pairing. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 4 (world_connection_partner_move, world_connection_player_move, world_connection_student_wander, world_connection_char_move_frozen).

column2: void world_build_character_quad(int part, float *verts, int direction, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Fills 4 vertices of 6 words {u, v, colour, x, y, z} for one part of a generic character sprite (same code as rel_field): the direction pair selects a group 0-3; the cell {u, v} comes from 0x12c10 (idle) or 0x12c18 (walking) + frame * 8 + group * 0x38 (other move states are used as a pointer); 0x33-pixel-wide cell in a 512 x 256 texture; part 1 rows v..v+0x3d, part 0 rows v+0x3d..v+0x54; x from -0.3984375 to the constant 0x12ea8, y from the constants 0x12e98-0x12ea4; colour 0xffffffff, z 0. No return value. Side effects: writes verts[0..23]. Callers: 1 (world_draw_character_sprite).

column2: void world_build_character_part_quad(int part, float *verts, int direction, int cell_id, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Fills 4 screen-space vertices for one part of a model-entry character (same code as rel_field): sprite cells from world_get_character_sprite_cell; projects the origin and a point 1.25 above it through projection * view * model (GU matrices read back, projection scaled by 64); 51-pixel-wide quad (x - 25 .. x + 26) in a 512 x 256 texture; part 0 a 50-row cell placed 80 - 12 pixels above the origin plus the per-frame offset, part 1 a 64-row cell from the origin to 64 - 12 pixels above; depths interpolated; u mirrored when the cell lookup reports a flip. Arguments 5-6 in t0-t1. VFPU matrix code; lower confidence. No return value. Side effects: writes verts[0..23]. Callers: 1 (world_draw_character_sprite_parts).

column2: void world_get_character_sprite_cell(int *out_u, int *out_v, int *out_offset, int *out_u2, int *out_v2, int *out_flip, int direction, int cell_id, int move_state, int frame)
column3: Maps direction 0-7 to a sprite column and mirror flag (0 -> 2, 1 -> 0, 2 -> 3, 3 -> 1, 4 -> 4, 5 -> 1 mirrored, 6 -> 3 mirrored, 7 -> 0 mirrored) and returns *out_u = column * 0x33 + 0xff when cell_id % 10 >= 5, *out_v = (cell_id % 10 % 5) * 0x32; *out_u2/*out_v2 from the animation table 0x12cf0 (idle) or 0x12cf8 (walking) + frame * 8 + column * 0x38; *out_offset (when not NULL) the signed byte 0x12e10 + column * 7 + frame (+1 when walking), else direction; *out_flip the mirror flag (same code as rel_field). Arguments 7-8 in t2-t3, 9-10 on the stack. Side effects: writes the outputs. Callers: 1 (world_build_character_part_quad).

Pushes the three GU matrices and loads screen-space ones: orthographic projection (-240, 240, -136, 136, -10000, 10000), identity view and model; leaves matrix mode 2. No return value. Side effects: GU matrix stacks. Callers: 1 (world_draw_character_sprite_parts).

Pops the model, view and projection matrices pushed by world_push_screen_matrices and leaves matrix mode 2. No return value. Side effects: GU matrix stacks. Callers: 1 (world_draw_character_sprite_parts).

column2: void world_get_cell_corners(float size, float *pos, float *c0, float *c1, float *c2, float *c3)
column3: Computes the four corners of the square footprint around pos: half = ((0.5 - size) - constant 0x12e94) * 0.5; corners pos + (-half, 0, -half), (+half, 0, -half), (-half, 0, +half), (+half, 0, +half). No return value. Side effects: writes c0-c3. Callers: 1 (world_connection_clip_motion).

Returns |v| = abs(sqrt(dot(v, v))) (the decompiler hides the float return in f0; the caller uses it as the speed). VFPU helpers; lower confidence. No side effects. Callers: 1 (world_connection_clip_motion).

Empty method of the character class: returns without doing anything (jr ra; nop, v0 not set). It fills slot +0xc (init) of the vtable 0x00014a08, whose layout in this module is {0, 0, destructor, init, update, draw, term} (checked against the named methods of the same vtables). No side effects. No direct caller (reached through the vtable at 0x00014a08).

column2: void world_connection_char_setup(void *ch, int kind, int team, float *pos)
column3: Initialises a 0x144-byte character: kind +0x108, team +0x10c, visible +0x44 = 1, state +0x48 = 0, gravity +0x38 = constant 0x12fe0, heading +0x40 = 0, position +0x20 = pos, velocity 0, trail ring (10 entries at +0x60) filled with pos, AI words +0x138..+0x140 defaulted. Character id +0x104: kind 1 -> word 0 of world_get_connection_params (model ids +0x110/+0x114/+0x118 from world_get_character_model_ids when world_character_has_field_model returns 1); kind 0 -> character 1; kind 2 (student) -> random entry of the 27-word table 0x12eb4 (team 1) or of the 24-word table 0x12f20 (team 3), with its model ids. Speed +0x3c = minimum 0x12fdc. Then the three AI words come from the character record (world_find_character): signed bytes +0x52 (style), +0x53 (speed mode), +0x54 (target preference). No return value. Side effects: the character. Callers: 3 (world_connection_game_spawn_leaders, world_connection_game_collect_students, world_connection_game_spawn_students).
